column1: # Pinned Lmod modules. Copied into each run when the run is created, so a run
# keeps its versions even if this file changes later.
# Change a pin deliberately, in its own commit, and start a new run. Never
# change one just to make a job start: a retired module is a decision point.
# HISAT2, SAMtools and Subread share the GCC 12.3.0 toolchain so they can be
# loaded together. Subread >= 2.0.2 needs --countReadPairs to count fragments.
